name: L-Train x 5 Infused Prerolls | The D OG
description:
Experience the timeless essence of old school terps with the D OG Atomik Dogwalker blunt 5-Pack. Infused with live resin and kief, these mini blunt-style pre-rolls deliver a rich, piney flavor with that signature OG pungency. 

Crafted from a premium (all flower) blend, The D OG is perfect for those who appreciate a highly potent, classic flavor. Enjoy the rich, relaxing experience of The D OG with every toke.
